newsitem.title: USA: Storm, rough seas forecast for Britain Tuesday - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Storm, rough seas forecast for Britain Tuesday - WSC.

text.p: A strong storm system is due to move across the West and South British Isles during Tuesday, Weather Services Corp said.
This could make for some rough seas and strong winds from the Atlantic across the English Channel. Shipping will be affected.

The high winds and rain moving rapidly west to east across the English Channel will spread eastward into mainland Europe along with windy conditions during midweek. Cooler temperatures will accompany the storm, it added.
